title: EATF Agent Evidence Package toolkit
description: Open toolkit for creating, inspecting, and offline-verifying Agent Evidence Packages (.aep): a hybrid RSA-4096 plus ML-DSA-65 signer, independent TypeScript and Python verifiers, sign/verify/inspect CLIs, RFC 9881 public-key encoding, JSON schemas, positive and negative conformance vectors, and a deterministic offline downgrade lab.
notes: Version 0.6.0 adds hybrid RSA-4096 plus ML-DSA-65 signing over identical canonical bytes, RFC 9881 SubjectPublicKeyInfo encoding with absent parameters, explicit if-present and required relying-party policies, a five-accepted/eight-rejected conformance corpus, and a deterministic six-package offline lab. Across six packages, two policies, and two independent implementations, all 24 verdict and first-failure-code observations agree. Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21763056. Reconnecting the GitHub integration started a new concept chain at 10.5281/zenodo.21763055; prior releases through v0.5.0 remain under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21511608.
